scenes.text: Bond prices took days to travel from Paris to Bordeaux
But the government had a secret weapon: semaphore towers

scenes.label: The towers
scenes.text: Every 12 km, with moving metal arms. Private messages banned

scenes.label: The bribe
scenes.text: The Blanc twins paid off a tower operator in Tours

scenes.label: The code
scenes.text: He sent a secret signal, then hit backspace to hide it

scenes.label: The spy
scenes.text: A lookout in Bordeaux read the signal before it vanished
They knew market moves days before anyone else
Two years later, the operator confessed on his deathbed

scenes.sub: No law covered private telegraph use
